summary: Landwirtschaftliche Rentenbank filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a public offering of U.S. dollar-denominated notes due in 2026, with a statutory guarantee by the Federal Republic of Germany. This is a standard debt issuance under an existing shelf registration (333-291690). The notes are not redeemable before maturity except for tax law changes in Germany. Application has been made to list on the Luxembourg Stock Exchange. There are no special-situation elements such as an acquisition, tender offer, restructuring, or management change. The filing is purely a routine capital markets transaction with no special-situation implications.
